items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: Like Lee Konitz “Motion” if you know that great record.

ctx.x: Now when you go over there and you’re playing with a local rhythm section, I have two questions. Did you carry charts with you, and when you play standards on the French horn do they fall within the range of the instrument? Do you move them?

Sometimes – rarely did I change keys but I might have – often, say in those years in the mid-‘80s if I would go to Europe and play with a new rhythm section I might bring one, an American sax player with me, and/or maybe an American drummer with me and we would play with a local bass player. Or maybe a local bass player and drummer. So it would be a mix of New Yorkers and Amsterdamers. And then we would – I usually did not have a piano, so I didn’t have to worry about telling the piano player how to do this, how…
Did you find that you play differently without a chordal instrument? And is it necessarily that you play more because you feel like you need to fill the space?
